summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO, Joint Company Secretary, and Authorized Representative Ms. Qu Cong, effective September 2, 2026, who will join Haidilao International. Ms. Li Lu, previously Deputy CFO, was appointed as her successor. No disagreement with the board was noted. The company also sought a waiver from strict compliance with HKEX Listing Rules 3.28 and 8.17 regarding secretary qualifications. This is a routine executive transition, not a special situation, but the abrupt CFO departure and related-party move to affiliate Haidilao merit monitoring for governance or control implications.
